title: 第 3 讲：定语从句 II —关系副词 where / when / why

reading.title: The Night the Deploy Failed

sentences.en: Last week we had an incident that delayed our release.
sentences.zh: 上周我们遇到一次事故，把发布推迟了。

sentences.en: Here is the timeline we wrote after the review.
sentences.zh: 下面是我们复盘之后写下的时间线。

sentences.en: The crash occurred at 9:10 p.m., the moment when the dashboard went red.
sentences.zh: 崩溃发生在晚上 9:10，也就是仪表盘变红的那一刻。

sentences.en: The reason why the deploy failed was a missing line in the background script.
sentences.zh: 部署失败的原因，是后台脚本里少了一行代码。

sentences.en: The office where the server sits was empty, so nobody noticed the logs until the engineer arrived.
sentences.zh: 服务器所在的那间办公室空无一人，所以没人注意到日志，直到工程师赶到。

sentences.en: We wonder about the schedule change that nobody mentioned, and we recall the day when the tests last passed.
sentences.zh: 我们琢磨着那个没人提过的日程变更，也回忆起测试上一次通过的那天。

sentences.en: We explain every incident on one page: the location in which it began, and the time that we spent fixing it.
sentences.zh: 现在我们把每次事故写进一页纸：它发生的地点，以及我们花在修复上的时间。

sentences.en: The page then reaches the team.
sentences.zh: 这页纸随后就传到整个团队手里。

reading.translation: 上周我们遇到一次事故，把发布推迟了。下面是我们复盘之后写下的时间线。崩溃发生在晚上 9:10，也就是仪表盘变红的那一刻。部署失败的原因，是后台脚本里少了一行代码。服务器所在的那间办公室空无一人，所以没人注意到日志，直到工程师赶到。我们琢磨着那个没人提过的日程变更，也回忆起测试上一次通过的那天。现在我们把每次事故写进一页纸：它发生的地点，以及我们花在修复上的时间。这页纸随后就传到整个团队手里。

keyPoints.sentence: we had an incident **that** delayed our release.
keyPoints.analysis: 关系代词对照组：that 在从句里作主语（The incident delayed...）→ 缺主语只能用关系代词。还原介词法过不去：delayed our release in the incident 不成立

keyPoints.sentence: The crash occurred at 9:10 p.m., **the moment when** the dashboard went red.
keyPoints.analysis: 先行词 the moment（时间）；从句 the dashboard went red 主谓齐全 → 关系副词 when。还原验证：the dashboard went red at the moment

keyPoints.sentence: **The reason why** the deploy failed was a missing line in the background script.
keyPoints.analysis: why = for which；从句 the deploy failed 主谓完整、缺原因状语 → 关系副词。注意：the reason is because… 是冗余错误（见 3.5）

keyPoints.sentence: ...the location **in which** it began, and **the time that** we spent fixing it.
keyPoints.analysis: 前半：in which 是 where 的正式变体（= the location where it began）；后半：the time 是 spent 的宾语 → 用 that / which，不能用 when（陷阱见 3.5）

notes.heading: 先定义：关系副词 / 关系代词

blocks.text: 先给术语定性，再谈规则 — 否则公式没有意义。

rows: 在定语从句里**只作状语**（不作主语、宾语）的引导词：where / when / why
The office **where** the server sits was empty.（where 作地点状语）
在定语从句里**作主语或宾语**的引导词：who / whom / which / that / whose
we had an incident **that** delayed our release.（that 作从句主语）

blocks.text: 一句话分野：**从句缺主语 / 宾语 → 关系代词；从句成分完整、缺的只是「地点 / 时间 / 原因」状语 → 关系副词。** 关系副词都等于「介词 + which」，所以它从不站主宾位。

notes.heading: 还原介词法（本讲核心工具）

blocks.text: **还原介词法**（定义卡）：把先行词带上合适的介词短语放回从句（in the office / at the moment / for the reason），看从句是否因此变得完整。放回去成立 → 从句缺的是状语 → 用关系副词；放不回去（从句缺主语或宾语）→ 用关系代词。

items: **摘从句**：把定语从句单独拎出来当独立句看（The server sits ___.）
**带介词还原先行词**：用「介词 + 先行词」补位（The server sits **in the office**.）— 成立且句意完整 → 关系副词（where = in which）
**放不回去就换关系代词**：an incident **that** delayed our release → **The incident** delayed our release，先行词站的是主语位 → that / which

rows: 成分完整、缺状语 → where（关系副词）

blocks.text: **一眼定位**：从句「主谓齐全」→ 关系副词；从句「缺主宾」→ 关系代词。关系词后面紧跟「主语 + 动词」多是前者，紧跟动词或动词后悬空多是后者。

rows: The office **where** the server sits was empty.
...we recall **the day when** the tests last passed.
The tests last passed **on the day**.

blocks.text: 口诀：**地点 where、时间 when、原因 why；介词跟着搭配走** —「介词 + which」是同一件事的正式写法。

notes.heading: 介词 + which 变体（正式语体）

blocks.text: 口语与一般写作用 where / when / why；事故复盘、正式报告等书面语倾向「介词 + which」，其中 **in which**（地点）、**during which**（时间段）最常见。

课文：the location **in which** it began（= the location where it began）；事故复盘常用：the two hours **during which** the dashboard stayed red（= the two hours when the dashboard stayed red）；原因变体：the reason **for which** the deploy failed（= the reason why the deploy failed）。
⚠️ 介词不能乱配：先看从句里动词 / 形容词的固定搭配，再把介词挪到 which 前面。sit **in** the office → **in** which；pass **on** the day → **on** which；fail **for** the reason → **for** which。where ≠ 永远 in which，用哪个介词由搭配决定。
**陷阱一：time / moment / day 作从句宾语时，用 that / which，不用 when**

rows: **the time that** we spent fixing it
~~the time when we spent fixing it~~
spent 缺宾语（the time 正是它的宾语），when 只作状语补不上宾语位
❌ when 只作状语，不作宾语

blocks.text: **陷阱二：the reason why… / the reason that… 都对；the reason is because… 是冗余错误** — ✅ The reason **why** the deploy failed is a missing line. / ✅ The reason is **that** a line was missing. / ❌ The reason is **because** a line was missing.（reason 与 because 语义重复 → 删 because 换 that，或直接说 A line was missing.）
非限制性从句（逗号 + which、which 指代整句）与 that 的禁入规则是 L04 的内容，本讲先不展开。

本讲课文英文共 109 词、词形 type 75 个，自然复现已入账旧词 13 个词条：release、review、crash、dashboard、deploy、fail、script、sit、notice、log、test、last、fix。原始分数 13/75 ≈ 17%（旧词词条 / 课文词形 type）；若按课文英文总词数计为 13/109 ≈ 12%。两种口径均 ≥ 10%（一册常规讲阶段目标），达标。

output.prompt: 用 2~3 句英文复述这份事故复盘。
output.sample:
Last week an incident delayed our release. The crash occurred at the moment when the dashboard went red, and the reason why the deploy failed was a missing line in the background script. Now we explain every incident on one page.
（范文仅供参考：覆盖「事故 → 时间线 → 原因 → 收尾」线索、含 when / why 关系副词、主干无错即可，不要求逐词一致。）

output.prompt: 以你经历过的一次线上事故或工作失误为主题写 4~5 句复盘，至少用 2 个关系副词和 1 个「介词 + which」变体。
output.reference:
参考起点：
Here is the timeline of the incident.
The error occurred at 3 a.m., the moment when the queue stopped.
The reason why the job failed was a bad retry.
We worked in the room where the logs are stored.（正式写法：the room in which the logs are stored）
I still remember the hour that we spent checking the logs.
output.sample:
Last month we had an incident that stopped the queue. The error occurred at 3 a.m., the moment when the alerts went silent. The reason why the job failed was a bad retry. We now work in the room in which the on-call laptop sits, and I still remember the hour that we spent checking the logs.
（范文仅供参考：4~5 句、2 个关系副词 + 1 个介词 + which、主干无错即可。）

checklist.label: 要点覆盖
checklist.text: 4~5 句、主题为一次事故 / 失误复盘、至少 2 个关系副词（where / when / why 不限组合）+ 1 个「介词 + which」变体

checklist.label: 自检要点
checklist.text: 逐句用「还原介词法」还原（先行词带介词放回从句是否成立）；关系副词的从句必须主谓完整、不缺主宾；time / hour / moment 类先行词作宾语时用 that / which 而非 when

checklist.label: 达标线
checklist.text: 每处关系词与从句缺口匹配，2 个关系副词 + 1 个介词 + which 全部用对，即通过

output.prompt: 用「还原介词法」逐句检查你仿写的定语从句：摘从句 → 带介词还原先行词 → 核对关系词。
output.reference: 检查顺序：① 摘出定语从句 → ②「介词 + 先行词」放回从句 → ③ 成立则用关系副词，缺主宾则用关系代词
output.sample:
例：We now work in the room in which the on-call laptop sits.
① 从句：the on-call laptop sits；② 还原：The on-call laptop sits in the room 成立；③ 成分完整、缺地点状语 → where = in which ✅
例：the hour that we spent checking the logs.
① 从句：we spent checking the logs；② 还原：We spent the hour checking the logs；③ 缺宾语 → that / which ✅（不能用 when）

practice.title: 选择关系词 — 用「还原介词法」判断从句缺什么，选出 where / when / why / that

questions.stem: This is the room ___ we hold the incident review.
questions.explanation: ① where（= in which）。依据一（语法规则）：从句 we hold the incident review 主谓宾齐全，缺的是地点状语 → 关系副词；that 站不了状语位。依据二（还原法）：We hold the incident review in the room 成立 → 状语缺口 → where。

questions.stem: I still remember the night ___ the database went down.
questions.explanation: ② when。依据一（语法规则）：从句 the database went down 主谓完整，缺时间状语 → when。依据二（还原法）：The database went down on the night 成立；填 that 会要求从句缺主宾，排除。

questions.stem: Tell me the reason ___ the build turned red.
questions.explanation: ③ why（= for which）。依据一（语法规则）：先行词 reason、从句 the build turned red 主谓完整 → why。依据二（还原法）：The build turned red for the reason 成立 → 原因状语缺口；排除 that。

questions.stem: The hour ___ we spent on the rollback felt endless.
questions.explanation: ④ that（= which）。依据一（语法规则）：从句 we spent 后面宾语悬空，the hour 是 spent 的宾语 → 关系代词，不能用 when。依据二（还原法）：We spent the hour on the rollback 成立 → 缺宾语，when 只作状语，排除。

questions.stem: The city ___ our data center is located is far from the coast.
questions.explanation: ① where。依据一（语法规则）：从句 our data center is located 主谓完整，缺地点状语 → where。依据二（还原法）：Our data center is located in the city 成立 → 状语缺口。

practice.title: 填空 — 用「介词 + which」变体把介词填进横线

questions.stem: The meeting room ___ which we ran the review was tiny.
questions.explanation: 依据一（语法规则）：run the review 的固定搭配是 run the review in the room → in which。依据二（还原法）：We ran the review in the meeting room 成立 → 介词用 in。

questions.stem: The two hours ___ which the dashboard stayed red felt endless.
questions.explanation: 依据一（语法规则）：先行词 the two hours 是时间段，从句动作持续该时段 → during which。依据二（改写还原）：The dashboard stayed red during the two hours 成立 → during。

questions.stem: The reason ___ which the deploy failed is clear now.
questions.explanation: 依据一（语法规则）：reason 的搭配是 the reason for sth，for which = why。依据二（还原法）：The deploy failed for the reason 成立 → for。

questions.stem: The morning ___ which the tests last passed was quiet.
questions.explanation: 依据一（语法规则）：具体某天上午 / 某天用介词 on（on Friday morning）→ on which。依据二（还原法）：The tests last passed on the morning 成立 → on。

practice.title: 改错 — 改正关系副词的误用

questions.stem: This is the time when we spent checking the logs.
questions.reference: This is the time that we spent checking the logs.（或 which，或省略关系词）
questions.explanation: 依据一（语法规则）：the time 是 spent 的宾语，缺宾语用关系代词，when 只作状语。依据二（还原法）：We spent the time checking the logs 成立 → 缺宾语；换成 when 后从句站不住。

questions.stem: The reason why the pipeline broke is because a lock expired.
questions.reference: The reason why the pipeline broke is that a lock expired.（或 The reason for the broken pipeline is a lock.）
questions.explanation: 依据一（语法规则）：reason 与 because 语义重复，表语从句用 that 引导。依据二（改写法）：删掉 because 后句子成立（The reason is that a lock expired.），原句双重标记原因 → 冗余。

questions.stem: The shelf which the backup drive sits is locked.
questions.reference: The shelf where the backup drive sits is locked.（或 on which）
questions.explanation: 依据一（语法规则）：从句 the backup drive sits 主谓齐全、缺地点状语 → 关系副词，which 只能作主宾。依据二（还原法）：The backup drive sits on the shelf 成立 → 状语缺口；which 无法还原。

questions.stem: The week which the migration ran was full of alerts.
questions.reference: The week when the migration ran was full of alerts.（或 during which）
questions.explanation: 依据一（语法规则）：从句 the migration ran 主谓完整，缺时间状语 → when / during which。依据二（还原法）：The migration ran during the week 成立 → 状语缺口，which 站不了状语位。

practice.title: 翻译 — 用关系副词或「介词 + which」翻译

questions.stem: 这就是我们进行事故复盘的会议室。
answers: This is the meeting room where we ran the incident review.
This is the meeting room in which we ran the incident review.
questions.explanation: 缺地点状语 → where / in which。依据一（语法规则）：从句 we ran the incident review 主谓宾齐全，缺的是地点状语 → 关系副词或「介词 + which」。依据二（还原法）：We ran the incident review in the meeting room 成立。

questions.stem: 我还记得数据库宕机的那一晚。
answers: I still remember the night when the database went down.
I still remember the night the database went down.
questions.explanation: 缺时间状语 → when（或省略）。依据一（语法规则）：从句 the database went down 主谓完整，缺时间状语 → when。依据二（还原法）：The database went down on the night 成立 → 状语缺口。

questions.stem: 流水线中断的原因是一个过期的锁。
answers: The reason why the pipeline broke was an expired lock.
The reason for which the pipeline broke was an expired lock.
questions.explanation: 缺原因状语 → why / for which。依据一（语法规则）：先行词 reason、从句 the pipeline broke 主谓完整 → why（正式变体 for which）。依据二（还原法）：The pipeline broke for the reason 成立；表语用名词短语 an expired lock，避免 the reason is because 的冗余写法。

practice.title: 判断下列 4 处正误 — 正确打 ✓，错误的改正

questions.stem: The office in which the team works is on the third floor.
questions.explanation: ✅ 正确。依据一（语法规则）：in which = where 的正式变体，从句 the team works 主谓完整、缺地点状语。依据二（还原法）：The team works in the office 成立 → 状语缺口，in which 合法。

questions.stem: That is the reason why we added the check.
questions.explanation: ✅ 正确。依据一（语法规则）：先行词 reason 用 why 引导定语从句，从句 we added the check 主谓宾完整。依据二（还原法）：We added the check for the reason 成立 → 原因状语缺口，why = for which。

questions.stem: The hour when the team spent on the rollback was painful.
questions.correction: The hour that the team spent on the rollback was painful.（或 which，或省略关系词）
questions.explanation: ❌ the hour 是 spent 的宾语，缺宾语用关系代词，when 不能作宾语。依据一（语法规则）：when 只作状语，宾语位要用 that / which。依据二（还原法）：The team spent the hour on the rollback 成立 → 缺宾语。

questions.stem: The reason is because a line was missing.
questions.correction: The reason is that a line was missing.（或直接说 A line was missing.）
questions.explanation: ❌ reason 与 because 语义重复，属冗余错误。依据一（语法规则）：表语从句用 that 引导，或不用 the reason 直接陈述原因。依据二（改写法）：换成 that 后句子成立；删去 The reason is 只留 A line was missing. 也成立。

practice.title: 造句 — 用关系副词写一次事故复盘

questions.stem: 以你经历过的一次线上事故或工作失误为主题写 4~5 句英文复盘，至少含 2 个关系副词（where / when / why 不限组合）和 1 个「介词 + which」变体，写完用「还原介词法」逐句自检。

checklist.label: 要点覆盖
checklist.text: 4~5 句、主题为一次事故 / 失误复盘、至少 2 个关系副词（where / when / why 不限组合）+ 1 个「介词 + which」变体

checklist.label: 自检要点
checklist.text: 逐句用「还原介词法」还原（先行词带介词放回从句是否成立）；关系副词的从句必须主谓完整、不缺主宾；time / hour / moment 类先行词作宾语时用 that / which 而非 when

checklist.label: 达标线
checklist.text: 每处关系词与从句缺口匹配，2 个关系副词 + 1 个介词 + which 全部用对，即通过
